newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Arnotts says extortion clouds outlook.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Arnotts says extortion clouds outlook.

text.p: Biscuit maker Arnotts Ltd said on Friday an extortionist's threat to poison its biscuits has placed a cloud over the future outlook for the company's earnings.
"Of course the product threat...now clouds the future outlook," Arnotts managing director Chris Roberts said.
The company simultaneously announced that its half year net profit before abnormals was A$33.2 million for the six months to January 24, down 14.2 percent from the previous corresponding half.
Roberts said the company was working in co-operation with the police and would do whatever it took to support the police effort.

"Arnotts has been making biscuits for 130 years and we intend to stay around for a long time yet. Our proud name has been built on the strong bond we share with our customers and we will do whatever it takes to protect that bond," Roberts said.
Arnotts is about 70 percent owned by Campbell Soup Co of the United States.
At 2.20 p.m. (0320 GMT), Arnotts shares were 35 cents weaker at A$8.40. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
